d:
The *New MG Setu in Patna* is one of the most important upcoming infrastructure projects in Bihar, being constructed over the *Ganga River* to ease traffic pressure on the existing Mahatma Gandhi Setu.
In this video, we bring you the *latest ground report* starting from *Zero Mile Patna,* covering the *approach roads, pier construction, superstructure launching, cable installation,* & future plans including a *massive 32-lane toll plaza.*
